key_facts: Catalog candidate: CASE 1840 UNI-LOADER SKID STEER LOADER, production 01/89–12/01; discovery is from a dated partial local index, so fitment is not user-confirmed.
The catalog does not expose a row explicitly named “engine drive belt.” A search for “drive belt” returned no matches; therefore no belt part number can be verified as the requested component.

The inspected matching engine service assembly is “02-06 - WATER PUMP SYSTEM, 4-390 ENGINE” (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader/engine/water-pump-system-4-390-engine/cn/3D628663-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/C9CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6). It contains belt-tensioner components, not an engine drive-belt row: J936203, description “BELT TENSIONER,” quantity 1, callout 18, product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/belts/engine-belts/belt-tensioner/p/J936203. J918944 is no longer available and directs ordering J936203 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/engines-cooling-exhaust/radiators/belt-tensioner/p/J918944).

Because the inspected evidence identifies a belt tensioner rather than the requested drive belt, it should not be substituted for the belt. Serial/PIN and engine/emissions configuration were not established.

key_facts: Machine candidate: 1845C CASE UNI-LOADER SKID STEER LOADER, North America, 01/85–12/95; discovery came from a dated partial local index, so fitment is not confirmed from serial/PIN evidence.

The inspected parking-latch/seat-bar assembly lists parking-brake-related cables as H438178, quantity 2, callout 26, description “CABLE; Lower,” and a separate H675012 parking-brake tube replacement kit. The row does not explicitly say “brake cable,” so the cable’s exact requested identity remains somewhat uncertain.
H675012 is explicitly a “KIT; Parking Brake Tube Replacement,” not a cable; it includes callouts 47–50. Do not substitute it for the requested cable.

The catalog also shows parking-latch/seat-bar variants, including dual and single seat-bar assemblies. The inspected occurrence was in the dual-seat-bar assembly with catalog coverage not established as complete; serial/PIN verification is advisable before ordering.

key_facts: Selected catalog candidate: 621B - CASE WHEEL LOADER (NORTH AMERICA), production 03/93–12/98. Discovery is from a dated partial index; fitment is not confirmed without serial/PIN verification.

The inspected STEERING CYLINDER assembly (Figure 5-18) lists G109152 as a spherical bearing, 34.92 mm ID × 55.56 mm OD × 30.15 mm W, self-aligning; catalog quantity 1 per cylinder, callout 2. This is the catalog component that most closely corresponds to a steering-cylinder ball joint, but the source does not call it a ball joint.

The steering hydraulic circuit assembly separately lists the same G109152 spherical bearing at callout 37, quantity 2 for the machine, associated with steering-cylinder mounting. It does not identify a separate ball-joint part.
The inspected steering-cylinder assembly identifies complete steering cylinder 1976862C1, quantity 2, with 84311413R as its remanufactured counterpart; these are not the requested joint.

A lexical search for “ball joint” found A76747 and 1974525C2 in foot-throttle assemblies and 311099A1 in a fuel-injection-pump assembly, but their inspected context is unrelated to steering cylinders and they are withheld.

Clarification: if you mean the steering-cylinder mounting spherical bearing, the observed candidate is G109152; confirm the cylinder/attachment configuration or serial/PIN before ordering. The catalog evidence does not verify a separately named steering-cylinder ball joint.

Both rows are described as “SPRING - return” and are verified in assembly https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/tractors/agricultural/naaa01agr100magnum7100series/case-ih-magnum-tractor/power-train/inching-pedal/cn/1E8B796F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FCD26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.","The catalog labels the parent assembly “INCHING PEDAL,” not “clutch pedal”; the clutch qualifier is established by the same assembly’s separate clutch-pedal rows. Serial/PIN break must be verified before ordering.","Machine discovery is a dated, partial local index: candidate catalog 7150 - CASE IH MAGNUM TRACTOR (01/87–12/93), machine_ref m1. Catalog evidence was observed 2026-11-04."],"sources":["https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/tractors/agricultural/naaa01agr100magnum7100series/case-ih-magnum-tractor/power-train/inching-pedal/cn/1E8B796F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FCD26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6","https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/chassis-frame/springs/spring/p/96897C2","https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/chassis-frame/springs/spring/p/1990620C1"],"store_url":""}

key_facts: The selected catalog is CASE 1840 Uni-Loader skid steer loader, production 01/89–12/01; discovery is a dated partial local index, so identity and fitment are not fully confirmed.
No catalog evidence was found for the supplied qualifiers “warp drive” or “plasma.” The catalog instead contains conventional fuel-injection components for the 4-390 engine.

Inspected assembly 03-11, “Fuel Injection Nozzle, 4-390 Emissions Certified Engine (Injection Pump J933090),” verifies J930573 — Fuel System Injector, quantity 4, callout 1, applicable with injection-pump qualifier/serial range “- 45636369, 45705902 -”; product link https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/engines-cooling-exhaust/case-engine-parts/fuel-system-injector/p/J930573.

The same inspected assembly lists J935036 — Nozzle, quantity 4, callout 1, for serial range 45636369–45705901; product link https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/engines-cooling-exhaust/case-engine-parts/nozzle/p/J935036.

Remanufactured alternatives are JR930573 for the J933090 pump and serial range - 45636369, 45705902 -, and JR935036 for J933090 and serial range 45636369–45705901; these are separate remanufactured parts, not established equivalents.

Because the requested “warp drive plasma injector” qualifier is absent from the inspected catalog evidence, no requested component can be uniquely identified. A serial/PIN or clarification that “plasma” and “warp drive” are fictional/non-catalog terms would be needed before selecting among the fuel-injector candidates.

For the 4-390 engine oil-pan/heater assembly, A77673 is described as an oil-pan gasket kit including callouts 4, 7, and 9; the callout-7 pan gasket is NSS (not sold separately). Assembly note: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader-north-america/engine/oil-pump-pan-heater-4-390-engine/cn/7E08F67D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D1CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

For the emissions-certified 4-390 engine oil-pan/heater assembly, A77673 likewise includes callouts 4, 7, and 9; the callout-7 pan gasket is NSS (not sold separately). Assembly note: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader-north-america/engine/oil-pump-pan-heater-4-390-emissions-certified-engine-asn-jaf0250483/cn/78C83E73-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D1CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

The 4-390 oil-pan assemblies differ by engine configuration and serial/engine-number qualification. The catalog does not establish which applies without locating the leak and identifying the engine configuration.

The oil-filter/cooler assembly also contains gaskets, cooler, plugs, and sealing components, so an underneath leak may originate there rather than at the oil pan. No part can be selected confidently from the symptom alone.
A search for part descriptions containing “leak” returned no matches; this is bounded catalog evidence, not proof that no leak-related part exists.

Focused clarification needed: where exactly is the oil appearing—around the oil-pan drain plug, pan-to-engine joint, oil filter/cooler area, or engine oil pump—and what engine/serial information is on the machine? Stop operation and clean/trace the leak before ordering.
